title: Factorio meets a supermarket where every worker is a robot (built with Claude Code)
author: gcphost
selftext:
I've been making games in my spare time on and off for several years, and after seeing everyone's stuff here I decided to give it a go purely with AI. I mostly play city and shop sims, so that's where I started.

It's called Sprocket & Stock. You start out stocking shelves and running the till yourself, then hire robots, then automate it all with conveyors, sorters and overhead belts. It runs in the browser, and there's co-op.

Play it: [https://sprocket-and-stock.pages.dev/](https://sprocket-and-stock.pages.dev/)

I've spent a few weeks' worth of tokens on it using Opus 5 and tried to dial it into an actual playable game with decent progression. All of the assets are database driven, and there's an MCP that lets me change most of the world. The idea was that my son and I could share the same world and add or change stuff as we played.

Happy to answer questions.
